name: std::type_info::~type_info
intro: Destructs an object of type std::type_info. This destructor is public virtual, making the std::type_info a polymorphic class.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
The dynamic type of a std::type_info subobject may be examined by the typeid operator.

It is unspecified whether the implementation calls this destructor for any std::type_info object at the end of the program.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
